decidedBy: Essenthos, read by Codex on 2026-10-05 against the held Synodal wording; awaiting human review

rulings.why: The held wording is Господа нашего Иисуса Христа. Christ is the Anointed title borne by the explicitly named Jesus, not Satan, who is named separately at position 2.

source: Essenthos, the Synodal Christ title in 1 Corinthians 5:5, read by Codex on 2026-10-05
policy: The Synodal prints Jesus Christ here, where the held Nestle and Scrivener witnesses print Jesus alone. Keep this added title and its explicitly named bearer local to this edition.
